final: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS patient_average FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(patient_average) AS overall_average FROM patient_averages), kept AS (SELECT p.ID, p.patient_average, p.patient_average - o.overall_average AS overall_difference FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.patient_average > o.overall_average), kept_average AS (SELECT AVG(patient_average) AS average_kept FROM kept) SELECT k.ID, k.patient_average, k.overall_difference, k.patient_average - a.average_kept AS kept_difference FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_average AS a WHERE a.average_kept IS NOT NULL ORDER BY kept_difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
